Agents: (A) Growth Hacker — experiments, viral loops, funnels, CAC/LTV [marketing/marketing-growth-hacker.md]; (B) Email Strategist — segmentation, lifecycle sequences, exit conditions, deliverability (adapted from real-estate to audience/deal outreach) [marketing/marketing-email-strategist.md].
Flow: Topic → growth plan → audience sequence → save to /agency/satyer-agency-marketing.jsonl.
Keys needed: Gemini API key ONLY (paste PASTE_GEMINI_API_KEY_HERE on Max, never in chat). Workflow INACTIVE — run manually only, nothing auto-runs. NO Facebook posting node: every post needs Jony's fresh per-post approval; drafts are saved to /agency/*.jsonl for review.
